data.name: Tukuna
data.gender_notes: Tukuna is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Tukuna is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'tukkana', meaning 'little elephant'. In Hindu culture, elephants are considered sacred animals and symbolize strength, power, and wisdom. The name Tukuna carries the meaning “Little Elephant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Tukuna usually hope their child will grow to embody little elephant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tukuna is a name that embodies the spirit of courage, strength, and wisdom. It is a reminder to remain steadfast in the face of challenges and to draw upon our inner resources to overcome obstacles.
data.etymology: Tukuna belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Elephant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tukuna total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
